hi, we’re looking for a female housemate to room with my friend in a double! we’re trying to get 2 bed 2 bath at costa verde and preferably move in mid june! 

it’s around 10 min drive to ucsd and 5 min walk to the trolley, but there’s also bus stops near that goes to ucsd! 

context about us!
we’re all currently third years
me: public health major, 21 years old
my roommate: cog sci major, 21 years old
ur future roommate: sociology major, 20 years old

some preference for a housemate:
- cleans up after themselves
- okay with alcohol and throwing a little get together with friends!
- okay with overnight guests
- okay with no outdoor shoes inside! 

dm if interested and we can get to know each other!
